name: family-meeting-framework
description:
Provides a structured framework for regular family meetings with agenda templates, age-appropriate participation strategies, decision-making processes, and follow-through tracking. Produces complete meeting formats with time allocations, facilitation scripts, and action item systems.
Use when the user asks about holding family meetings, creating a family decision-making process, or establishing regular family communication routines.
Do NOT use for family therapy sessions, crisis intervention, or workplace meeting facilitation.
